item: GSM title vs description subject IDs
data: title and description name different COR subject IDs for 6/8 GSMs (only GSM6603102 COR-1726 and GSM6603109 COR-1433 agree); disease labels attach to GSM rows, so case/control assignment of matrix columns depends on which field is correct
disposition: recorded; case refused at design for a reason independent of this (no exercise contrast)
